Steady Nerves.name: Steady Nerves
Steady Nerves.description:
🧘 Fear still comes, but it no longer decides for you.

🎯 Good for keeping your head when things go wrong.
📋 Requires level 8 and Willpower 8.

📈 Grants: Willpower +10
Steady Nerves.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has faced enough danger to keep their head: they feel fear and act anyway. Show steady breathing, clear decisions under threat and a refusal to be rushed by intimidation or a killer's stare. Limits: they are brave, not fearless; trauma still leaves marks, and strong mind-affecting Quirks can still take hold, though the character fights them harder.
